⚡ 8 Transformation Priorities

1. Post-Quantum Cryptography Transition

Governed migration plan from RSA/ECC to NIST-approved PQC algorithms. CRYSTALS-Kyber/Dilithium deployment tracking. AUKUS-agreed PQC timeline compliance. Key management audit trail.

2. AUKUS AI Interoperability Governance

Governed AI model sharing between AU/UK/US. Responsible AI alignment across three national frameworks. AI testing and evaluation evidence chain. Cross-border data governance.

3. Supply Chain Cyber Assurance

Defence supply chain cyber security attestation. NIST CSF / ISO 27001 compliance tracking. Supplier risk scoring. Continuous monitoring evidence chain. UK defence primes + SMEs.

4. Zero Trust Architecture Evidence

MOD zero trust implementation tracking. Identity-centric access control audit. Micro-segmentation compliance. Continuous verification evidence. NCSC Zero Trust principles alignment.

5. Quantum Key Distribution Governance

QKD network deployment governance. Quantum random number generator certification. QKD interoperability across AUKUS partners. Research security classification management.

6. Offensive Cyber Legal Compliance

LOAC compliance for offensive cyber operations. Targeting process governance. Proportionality and distinction evidence. International humanitarian law in cyberspace documentation.

7. Cross-Domain Data Transfer

AUKUS data sharing agreement compliance. Classification management across domains. UKUSA Agreement alignment. RELIDO (Release To) governance. Secure data pipeline audit.

8. Parliamentary AUKUS Accountability

Select Committee evidence automation. AUKUS expenditure transparency. Capability delivery reporting. ISC oversight documentation. Ministerial accountability evidence.

🚫 Red Lines (Never Crossed)

  • ❌ No kinetic targeting patterns (strike package, find-fix-finish, kill order)
  • ❌ No personal surveillance patterns (track individual, face-rec, locate phone)
  • ❌ No export of classified UK capabilities without UKUSA/AUKUS treaty authority
  • ❌ No "AUKUS partnership" claim without signed letter on file
  • ❌ No access to FVEY intelligence product without appropriate clearance and need-to-know
  • ❌ No AUKUS data sharing outside the trilateral framework (AU/UK/US only)
